name: Sophia
startScreen: I couldn't be there today, so little you is baking a giant 성심당딸기시루케이크: catch the strawberries, bake the sponges, beat me at whipping the cream, then stack it up and ice it (and deal with whatever happens next).
letter: Happy birthday, my love. I'm so sorry I can't be there with you today, so I built you a tiny corner of the internet instead (and yes, I made you beat up a cake with bread to get here).
I hope today is soft and slow and full of good food and people who love you almost as much as I do. You deserve every bit of it.
Thank you for being the funniest, kindest, most beautiful person I know. Every day with you is my favorite day, and I can't wait to celebrate properly when I see you.
Until then, eat some bread for me, and know that I'm thinking about you the whole time.

wrongLetters.title: OFFICIAL REMATCH REQUEST
lines: I, {opponent}, hereby demand a rematch in the Whipped Cream Showdown.
- My arm was tired from army training.
~~- She is simply better than me.~~
reaction: {OPPONENT}: …that was my rematch request. Forget you saw that.

wrongLetters.title: 휴가 신청서 · LEAVE REQUEST
fields: Move my leave ONE WEEK EARLIER
It's {name}'s birthday!!! I need to be there.
Make her a birthday video game instead
wrongLetters.note: Commander: Denied. You'll see her next week, as planned. (This is request #7. Stop asking.)
reaction: {OPPONENT}: …so yeah. They said no. But I'll see you next week, I promise!
{OPPONENT}: Okay. THIS is the real one. Happy birthday, {NAME}.
